notes.title: Update on Early Access release for Close Your Eyes -Anniversary Remake-
notes.content:
A little bit of an update, this is not 100% yet, but it's looking mighty likely and I want to let you guys know ahead of time.

It's looking like Close Your Eyes -Anniversary Remake- will release in Early Access on December 11th, it will cost $4.99 USD and have a 10% off launch discount. It also will be on sale for 10% off during the Winter Sale, but I highly recommend if planning to pick it up to pick it up during these sales. I'll be releasing a big update and up'ing the price to $5.99 in late January/early February, and then throughout 2019 as some big updates hit, I'll gradually raise the price more and more until the final price, which is planned to be $8.99 USD. The price it'll be during December at 10% off $4.99 USD is literally the cheapest the game is going to be for at least the next three years, so heads-up on that one.

Want to make early adopters be benefited rather than people who wait for a sale.

Anyways, the Early Access release on it's initial release on December 11th will include the complete remake of Girl's Graveyard in it, playable from start to finish. The remake features new areas, new scenes, a new ending, but is not as drastic of a remake as the CYE one and should take someone probably around 1-2 hours to complete (depending on several factors).

It'll include Close Your Eyes: The Twisted Puzzle, which is more of a port of the DLC than it is a remake, but an enhanced port which includes some new things with its endings, a few new secrets, and a new areas, plus some altered puzzle solutions.

The Close Your Eyes remake on Early Access release is not fully playable yet, it'll be playable up until the "Pancake" scene from the original Close Your Eyes, but the path to get to that pancake scene is longer with new areas, story, reimagined areas, and more up until that point. I will also be working with the community, asking questions, collecting feedback to help direct the remake going forward,I plan to be very active and vocal about CYE-AR-.

Just thought I'd let you guys know ahead of time on all of this, if the date changes, I'll let you know.
